retrievalProfile.description: A somber, high-contrast digital collage featuring a central portrait integrated with ethereal cloud-based memorial imagery and script typography.
triggerTerms: high contrast monochrome hip hop art

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex layered composition where a primary high-contrast portrait is flanked by a dark, starry sky and a heavenly upper tier of faded, glowing portraits emerging from thick white clouds.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary subject dominates the right foreground
Secondary memorial portraits float in the upper third
Text is centered horizontally in the left mid-ground
Dark textured ground provides a base for the composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast desaturated color palette with a single red accent
Ethereal cloud texture separating the upper and lower sections
Grainy, film-like texture across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait on the right; smaller full-body figures in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face of the main subject on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the main portrait, moves left to the red script text, then upward to the memorial faces in the clouds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, primarily found in the dark starry areas of the mid-left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and glowing highlights in the clouds and faces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson red for the primary script title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between deep shadows and blown-out highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the upper serif text
Fluid, connected strokes for the lower script text
High contrast between the two styles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the 'D' and 'L' in the script font

composition.relationshipToImage: focal point of the left side

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean, spaced-out serif with a dense, expressive script.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom left corner

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif look for the top line
Elegant but legible script for the title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, grainy collage. On the right, a high-contrast profile of a man. Across the top, a row of faded, glowing portraits emerging from thick white clouds. The middle-left should be a dark starry sky, and the bottom should show a dark grassy field with a small figure walking away.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a white, wide-tracked serif font in the middle-left. Below it, add the album title in a large, crimson red script font with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the red script the most saturated element?
Are the upper portraits properly blended into the clouds?
Is the grain/noise texture consistent across the image?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos

mustAchieve: High-contrast lighting on the main subject
avoid: Hard edges on the floating portraits

postGenerationChecks: Verify the red script is centered relative to the serif text
Ensure the cloud layer creates a clear horizontal division
Confirm the grain texture is visible in the dark areas
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + Cloud-based memorial tier + Wide-tracked serif + Red script title
